grants.description: Verify your identity as the business owner or responsible person
grants.purpose: To confirm you are legally responsible for the food business and can register it

grants.description: Share your food business details with the local authority
grants.purpose: To register your food business and create an inspection record with the local authority

grants.description: Share information about food handling and preparation activities
grants.purpose: To assess food safety risk and determine appropriate inspection frequency

grants.description: Consent to unannounced food safety inspections by environmental health officers
grants.purpose: Food businesses must be inspected to ensure compliance with food hygiene regulations

grants.description: Share registration and inspection data with the Food Standards Agency
grants.purpose: FSA maintains national food safety records and publishes food hygiene ratings

revocation.mechanism: Contact your local authority to close or transfer your food business registration
revocation.effect: Registration closure means you must cease food business operations. You cannot revoke consent for inspection while operating a food business.

delegation.limitations: Agent can complete the registration form on your behalf but cannot provide false information about food safety practices. Agent cannot make decisions about business operations or food handling procedures. Final submission requires your explicit confirmation that all details are accurate.
